meta.notes: Visual behavior analysis focusing on hand and object interaction. No audio assumptions.

global_instructions.system_prompt: Analyze visual behavior of hands from this egocentric, first-person point of view video. Use only visible cues and ignore audio. Return EXACTLY one label from {choices}. Output the label ONLY. No punctuation, no extra words, no sentences.

presets.title: Current Hand Action
presets.question: What is the current visible hand action? Choose one: pointing, grabbing toy, handing away the toy, holding toy still, manipulating toy, gesturing, touching a person, on the ground, on some furniture, opening a box or bag, waving, holding paper, resting, none.

presets.title: Current Toy Interaction
presets.question: Which toy is currently visible? Choose one: none, giraffe, elephant, red toy, green toy.
